identification: Three graduated lithographed tin children's sand pails, pale blue and yellow with sailor boy, children, seal/turtle, fish and jellyfish. Unmarked in photos; style looks like 1930s-50s English or Australian tinplate (Chad Valley / Ohio Art type). Rusty inside, worn print.

entries.venue: Armitage Auctions, Launceston sale 27763 lot 1473 (paid locally)
entries.note: Vintage child's sand bucket and spade, single. Database hit only; paid locally, shows what we might pay, not a resale price. No FX needed.
Group of 8 lithographed tinplate toy cars; only a loose category guide for lithographed tin, and over 10 years old. Not sand pails.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work): tin sand bucket; sand pail; lithographed tin toy; children tin bucket; tinplate bucket; toy bucket; beach pail; sand bucket. No resale comps for tin sand pails.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'vintage tin sand pail lithographed', 'Chad Valley sand bucket', 'Ohio Art sand pail', 'tin sand bucket sailor'; also Leski, Lawsons and Noble Numismatics sold for 'tin sand bucket' / 'tinplate pail'; WorthPoint 'lithograph tin sand pail set of 3'. Check whether graduated sets of 3 sell above singles.
viewing_check: Look for a maker name or country stamp on the base or under the rim (Chad Valley, Ohio Art, Wells, Made in England/Australia), and confirm rust perforation, dents and print loss on all three.
